design_summary: Single fused Triton kernel for chunk_gated_delta_rule_fwd_h with state-store semantics matching the framework golden, fp32 accumulator, overflow-safe clamping, and packed varlen state layout.
key_fixes: Fixed state-store semantics: kernel stores POST-update state S at each chunk index to match the golden recurrence order.
Added overflow-safe clamping (|x| <= 1e20) for v_new, gated update, and updated state to prevent fp32 accumulation Inf/NaN.
Fixed varlen state indexing: state_bh is the head id matching packed [1,HV,total_NT,K,V] output layout.
Corrected the copied framework golden for varlen mode (NT computation, batch_idx=0, sequence offsets, finite clamp).
Preserved fp32 accumulator, tl.dot(..., input_precision='ieee'), host flattening, k head-group map, and multibuffer/unit_flag launch options.
